items.html: However, its end is soft: for when she has finished taking all those judgments sawed from the male, she has nothing more to give. And it was that in the Nukva her strength was mighty at first, all the while she takes judgments from the male; but when she has finished enacting the judgments she received from him, she has nothing more to give, and her strength weakens, and behold she is soft. But the male is not so, for he does not need any other; and the more he proceeds, the more he grows stronger. On the contrary, his head is soft and his end is hard.
